purpose: RUN 2 structured WM-S training config = run-1 defaults + junction fix (active) + merge_cal ON + entries-v2 (trainer) + traffic-level losses + 300 s curriculum; state-noise injection OFF.
junction_fix: active by default (wms.presence + train loss_valid + wms_eval wms_plugin)

merge_cal.applied_via: PhysicsConfig.from_params_file (unknown keys filtered, null values keep defaults)

entries.note: observed pre-t0 history arrivals occupy free padding slots; excluded from per-car loss

traffic_losses.note: final flag names confirmed against the merged wms.cli --help by run2_chain.sh

noise_injection.note: B4 state-noise is available in the merged trainer; run 2 keeps it OFF

projection.note: differentiable per-step feasibility projection (min gap, speed, lane); logs projection-active fractions

residual_cap.note: default caps recommended by the wms/stab branch (R2_STABILITY.md suggested usage)

contractive_regulariser.note: small weight; relu(amplification - margin) on the residual net

conservation.note: vehicle-count metric on_road == initial + entered - exited is logged; loss term OFF (stab branch does not recommend enabling it)

budget.note: plan_steps chooses per-stage optimizer steps; refuse to start above the 8 h cap
